patthana8.51:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana8.51:2.1: na asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asaṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā na asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saṃkiliṭṭho ca na asaṃkiliṭṭho ca dhammā uppajjanti, hetupaccayā.
patthana8.51:3.1: na saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ca na asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca na saṃkiliṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana8.51:4.1: hetuyā pañca, avigate pañca. (sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.) na kilesasampayuttaṃ
